thread:
Nina (Design): quick UX check: refining the batch vectors inspector + export microflow. focus areas: compact row density, export modal copy, and keyboard + screen reader flow. latest mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz-embed-inspector
Owen (Product): echo: customers want a very compact inspector for large lists. default collapse for >250 rows? also many ask for an opt-in source_text column for rerank context.
Peyton (Eng): collapse-by-default ok. suggest virtualization for lists >500. don't render full preview until expand to save CPU.
Quinn (A11y): accessibility notes: 1) toggles need aria-expanded and aria-controls. 2) expanded panel must receive focus. 3) announce load counts with aria-live polite.
Rosa (QA): found copy divergence: modal header says "Export embeddings" but CTA is "Download CSV". pick one and make i18n-friendly. Also add test for CSV with localized number formats.
Sam (Support): can we show example headers in modal (collapsed)? reduces "where's my source text" tickets. Also add a short privacy hint when source_text is checked.
Nina (Design): proposal:
- Title: "Export embeddings"
- Helper: "Contains vector ids, scores, and embeddings. Toggle to include original source text (opt-in)."
- Checkbox: "Include original source text (opt-in)"
- Primary: "Download"
- Example toggle: "Show example headers"
Thoughts?
Owen (Product): change primary to "Download CSV" to be explicit. add small note: "Up to 10k vectors; larger exports run in background and you'll receive a link."
Peyton (Eng): backend choices: CSV with floats (huge), JSONL.gz (better), or CSV with base64 embeddings. proposal: default CSV for <=1k, JSONL.gz for >1k and background job for >10k.
Quinn (A11y): background export must post accessible notification when complete (role=alert, link to file). job list should expose status to screen readers.
Rosa (QA): QA checklist items: keyboard-only expand/collapse, modal focus trap, aria announcements for export start/completion, CSV parse tests in Excel/Sheets, background job cancel flow.
i18n-bot: note: avoid concatenation like "Includes %d vectors" -> use single placeholder string for translators.
Sam (Support): suggested privacy line: "Source text is included only in downloaded files; do not upload to third-party services." Keep short.
Peyton (Eng): rough estimates: virtualization ~3 dev days, export + background jobs + notifications ~6 dev days. storage ops TBD.
Nina (Design): action items: update Figma copy + add example block; Quinn to post a11y acceptance criteria; Peyton to spec server export behavior; Rosa to draft QA tests; Sam to write support blurb. I'll push updates in ~2 hours. :rocket:
